cleaning_decisions.action: Removed 62 duplicate records matching identical (building, timestamp) tuples.
cleaning_decisions.rationale: Energy meters emit exactly one cumulative interval reading per hour. Redundant rows skew sum KPIs.

cleaning_decisions.action: Dropped 6 records containing unparseable or corrupted timestamp strings.
cleaning_decisions.rationale: Chronological integrity is mandatory for temporal trend analysis and peak hour detection.

cleaning_decisions.action: Normalized 18 building names with inconsistent casing or extra whitespace.
cleaning_decisions.rationale: Ensures clean group-by aggregations and prevents fragmented building cards.

cleaning_decisions.action: Inverted signs for 30 negative consumption values (sensor polarity errors).
cleaning_decisions.rationale: Submeters occasionally invert current transformer (CT) polarity during maintenance.

cleaning_decisions.action: Imputed 24 missing units_kwh values using building-specific hourly median.
cleaning_decisions.rationale: Median preserves diurnal patterns without introducing artificial spikes.

cleaning_decisions.action: Reset 30 anomalous voltage readings (<180V or >270V) to nominal 230V.
cleaning_decisions.rationale: Campus line frequency and voltage regulators maintain 230V ± 10% under standard operation.

cleaning_decisions.action: Identified 34 extreme statistical outliers (>2.5x IQR) and capped them to the 99th percentile.
cleaning_decisions.rationale: Prevents telemetry dropouts/overflows (e.g., 99999 kWh) from distorting university budget projections.
